design_principle: One Experience record = one real, dated event in PB's development-intelligence history. Fields mirror the 8 requested primitives exactly, each reusing an existing, locked vocabulary from PHASE-940..970 wherever one exists -- no new evidence taxonomy, no new status taxonomy, no new action-type taxonomy.

fields.phase: string -- the real PHASE-NNN this experience originates from
fields.experience_kind: 'successful_resolution' | 'honest_negative_reconfirmation' | 'misjudgment_correction' | 'partial_progress' -- the 4 patterns this phase was asked to make representable
fields.context: { goal_id, capability_ids[], state_before: { functional_status, execution_state? } } -- snapshot of what was true immediately before this experience
fields.problem: string -- the specific question/issue this experience addresses
fields.decision: { decision_summary, decided_at_phase, corrects_experience_id?, decided_by?: string, status?: 'provisional'|'final', cause_review_note?: string, intervention_tested_claimed_cause?: boolean, direct_support_evidence?: Array<{ evidence_ref, evidence_sha256, evidence_location, quote, scope_claim, used }> } -- what was decided; corrects_experience_id links a correction back to the experience it corrects, making misjudgment_correction a first-class, queryable relationship rather than free text. decided_by is an optional non-empty identity string for the actual decision maker, populated only from explicit real evidence; omit when unknown, never infer from the executor or agent_id, never backfill existing records. CR-16: cause_review_note is optional non-empty text and requires a valid CR-06 reference to exactly one earlier canonical Experience. intervention_tested_claimed_cause is optional and strictly boolean. Both are explicitly supplied, never inferred from Outcome/result; missing remains unspecified. Original Cause and historical records remain unchanged. No causal verdict enum, autonomous reassessment claim or promotion authorization. CR-17: prospective direct-support declarations only. Each entry requires an exact repository ref/SHA/JSON Pointer, quote equal to the resolved JSON value without coercion or summarization, non-empty author-written scope_claim, and explicit boolean used. No inferred/default used value. Absent or empty declarations assert no consumption coverage; unrelated evidence is not scanned. Quote equality does not prove comprehension or scope correctness, and summary/status alone does not authorize broader claims. No historical backfill or automatic Knowledge/Principle promotion. CR-17 requiredness supplement: a new Experience with action.action_type exactly reverification requires non-empty direct_support_evidence. Existing IDs in the SHA-pinned index-v6 boundary remain exempt from requiredness only; other action types retain optional behavior. See CR-17 for the immutable boundary. No action-type inference or mislabel-bypass protection.
fields.action: { action_type (reuses PHASE-943/947's infra_restoration|code_fix|process_redesign, plus 'investigation'|'reverification' for non-remediation events), action_summary, real_or_simulated: 'real' -- this phase only maps real events }
fields.evidence: { evidence_kind (reuses PHASE-944/945's EvidenceInput taxonomy), evidence_category (reuses PHASE-947/948's locked 6-category taxonomy), evidence_source, evidence_detail } -- never a new vocabulary, always the same one the resolvers already use
fields.result: { functional_status_before, functional_status_after, execution_state_before?, execution_state_after? } -- reuses PHASE-943 fixed semantics values
fields.cause: { root_cause_summary, cause_type: 'real_infra_dependency'|'code_data_wiring_bug'|'evidence_misapplication'|'taxonomy_quality_issue'|'external_environment_limitation', evidence_ref?: string, evidence_sha256?: string, evidence_location?: string } -- evidence_ref/evidence_sha256/evidence_location are optional, additive, and governed by CR-15: if any one is present all three MUST be present and MUST resolve (real file, matching SHA, valid RFC 6901 pointer) using the same pattern as problem_context; absence requires nothing and is never inferred, generated, or backfilled. This validates only that a cited reference genuinely resolves -- it does not validate cause_type correctness and does not require any cause_type<->action_type/result relationship. Prospective only; no existing record is migrated.
fields.lesson: string -- the generalized takeaway, written for a future reader/mechanism, not just a restatement of the result
fields.links: { goal_ref, gap_ref (nullable), dependency_ref (nullable), capability_refs[], assignment_ref?: string, provenance_source?: 'LEGACY'|'OJT'|'EXTERNAL', external_source?: { provider, model, access_path?, requested_model?, actual_model?, actual_model_evidence?: { ref, sha256, location }, response_evidence_ref, response_evidence_sha256?, selection_reason?, query_evidence_ref?, query_evidence_sha256?, validation?, missing_knowledge?, alternative_reasoning? }, verifies_external_experience_id?: string, tutor_outcome_evaluation?: { candidate_ref, candidate_sha256, validation_assessment, missing_knowledge_assessment, alternative_reasoning_assessment, overall_consultation_outcome, outcome_evidence_ref?, outcome_evidence_sha256? } } -- every ref MUST resolve against real goal_model.json / trace / overlay data (validated programmatically below, not just asserted). assignment_ref is an optional non-empty repository-relative reference to an existing real assignment/task brief; omit when no evidence exists. It does not assert agent selection, execution, or outcome. provenance_source/external_source/verifies_external_experience_id are optional, additive, and governed by CR-09..CR-12 (see connection rules) -- absence is UNCLASSIFIED, never auto-LEGACY. Tutor query evidence additionally requires problem_context = { problem, source_ref, source_sha256, source_field_location, action_type?, cause_type? }. source_field_location is an RFC 6901 JSON Pointer selecting either the exact problem string or an object with problem; optional types must exactly match that source object (direct action_type/cause_type or nested action.action_type/cause.cause_type). No classification or inference. Existing query SHA binds this context; no duplicate Candidate context is introduced. For access_path CLI_SUBSCRIPTION, requested_model is required and model is its compatibility alias, never proof of actual serving identity; actual_model must be explicit and may be UNKNOWN. Query/response snapshots must preserve access_path and requested_model. A non-UNKNOWN actual_model requires SHA-verified evidence and an RFC 6901 location matching that value, bound to candidate_id/provider/query SHA. Unknown actual_model has no evidence claim. Provider is explicit and must match provenance, never inferred from executable names. Legacy API model semantics are unchanged. models_cache is a separate operational gap, never a provenance source. Tutor consultation candidates additionally require the fields and invariants in CR-13; response SHA is mandatory for that contract. Optional tutor_outcome_evaluation uses exactly the four enum sets in services/genieTutorOutcomeEvaluationContract.mjs. Definitive assessments require SHA-bound independent verifier/execution Outcome evidence, never Tutor response or self-score; UNKNOWN/PENDING/INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE need no invented outcome. Provider/model remain on the referenced original Candidate, no scores or thresholds. Corrections reuse CR-06 and preserve CR-11/13 lineage. Outcome evaluation never authorizes CR-12 promotion. No default, inference, or migration of existing records.

explicitly_out_of_scope_this_phase: Self-Improvement (using experiences to change future behavior)
Any new resolver or automatic experience-generation mechanism
